probability_conditioning: all observations in each continuous run, fitted parameters and fixed class/phase mapping
observation_intervals: phase posteriors held within their flow observation interval; not new independent measurements
event_timing: IC/TO scores only at exact observation boundary frames; run starts/gaps/other display frames are NaN
missing_semantics: state and latent-boundary posteriors remain available; stance/swing and IC/TO are NaN
calibration: model-conditional posterior; no empirical calibration without ground truth
